document.title: Plant storage note, Kochi bales
document.summary: Natural rubber bales from the Kochi supplier are kept on pallets in the covered bay and issued first in, first out. A bale stored for more than ninety days is given an ageing check before it goes to mixing. Dirt content and volatile matter are trended per supplier lot, so drift shows before the material reaches the mixer. Supplier feedback with the lot data attached goes out every month.

document.title: Teardown findings, failed 33 kV cable joints, July to September 2026
document.summary: Teardown findings, failed 33 kV cable joints, July to September 2026 Failure analysis by the field service team of Raychem RPG, November 2026. Six failed joints were cut open and checked for the four causes in the set order. Water entry was the cause in 3 joints, a preparation error in 2 and a connector defect in 1. No joint failed from overload.

document.title: Responsible AI use, group guidance note
document.summary: Responsible AI use, group guidance note Guidance for every company of the group, issued in October 2026. An AI assistant is used only through the approved gateways of the company. No confidential data of a customer, a supplier or an employee is put into a prompt. A person reads and approves every output before it is used in work that leaves the team.

document.title: Pilot results, AI-assisted code review in four delivery teams
document.summary: title: Pilot results, AI-assisted code review in four delivery teams summary: Four delivery teams used an AI assistant for the first pass of every code review for 12 weeks. A person approved every change. The median time from opening a change to its approval fell from 19 hours to 11 hours. Errors found in review rose from 3.1 to 4.4 for every 1,000 changed lines.

document.summary: Group integration forum, minutes of September 2026 Meeting of 15 September 2026. Present: the integration leads of KEC International and Zensar, the head of finance processes of the group and the head of people operations of the group. Decisions From 1 October 2026 every integration in the group follows one rule: a system cut-over starts only after the process owner signs off the target process.

document.title: Material specification, natural rubber grades and storage limits
document.summary: Material specification, natural rubber grades and storage limits Specification of the raw material team of CEAT, revision 4, valid from 1 September 2026. A lot of natural rubber is accepted when all four incoming tests of its grade are inside the limits of the table below. A lot that is past the time-to-use limit of its grade is issued to mixing only after it passes the storage ageing check.

document.title: Warehouse storage audit, Plant 3, April to June 2026
document.summary: Warehouse storage audit, Plant 3, April to June 2026 Audit of 6 and 7 July 2026 by the raw material team of CEAT. All four bays of the raw material warehouse are covered and ventilated, and every bale of natural rubber stood on a pallet. 1,180 of the 1,229 issue lines followed first in, first out. 11 of the 412 lots in store were past the time-to-use limit of their grade.

document.title: Systems cut-over runbook for an acquired unit
document.summary: Systems cut-over runbook for an acquired unit This runbook is the cut-over part of the integration playbook. It is used when the systems of an acquired unit move to the systems of the buyer. A cut-over starts only after the process owner signs off the target process. Both toolchains stay in use until that sign-off, and the old tools are retired in phases.

document.title: Integration review, first 100 days of the overseas unit
document.summary: Integration review, first 100 days of the overseas unit Review by the project management office of KEC International, July 2026. The purchase and invoice systems of the acquired unit were cut over on day 21, before the process owners were agreed. Site teams rebuilt their old steps as 14 workarounds outside the new system. Local labour, contract and payment terms were first reviewed on day 63.
